name: Wavegrain
description: Read your brands, make TikTok slideshows and Instagram carousels from your own photos, edit slides, schedule posts and export them through Wavegrain's hosted remote MCP server.

auth.instructions: Authenticates via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE in your browser using your Wavegrain account. On the consent page you pick the permissions and a daily credit limit; making slideshows spends credits from your Wavegrain account (Wavegrain is a paid product).
